title: VH-92 Presidential Helicopter Crew Chief (MGySgt to LCpl) NMOS (any PMOS from 60/61/62/63/64/65), DC AVN
raw_text:
20. MOS 6181, VH-92 Presidential Helicopter Crew Chief (MGySgt to LCpl) NMOS
(any PMOS from 60/61/62/63/64/65), DC AVN

    a. Summary. VH-XX Presidential Helicopter Crew Chiefs are flight
crewmembers that perform duties incident to the maintenance and operation of
Marine VH-XX Helicopters of the Executive Flight Detachment at HMX-1.

       b.   Prerequisites

            (1) Must have normal color perception.

            (2) Must have WS-B(+) water survival qualification.

        (3) Must volunteer for duties involving flight as an aircraft
crewmember.

            (4) Must be skill qualified in a PMOS from OccFld 60, 61, 62, 63, 64,
or 65.

        (5) Security requirement:      top secret security clearance eligibility
with yankee white (YW) access.

       c.   Requirements

        (1) Meet the requirements of reference (ah), and the reference (ai),
USN Manual of the Medical Department with normal depth perception.

        (2) Satisfactory performance in primary MOS duties for the initial 6
months of assignment to the HMX-1 Executive Flight Detachment.

        (3) Must complete the Plane Captain (PC) Ground Syllabus for type
aircraft.

        (4) MOS awarded upon certification by CO HMX-1 to MMOA that Marine
has completed all requirements contained in appropriate NATOPS manual or
syllabi peculiar to the VH-XX helicopter.

    d. Duties. For a listing of duties and tasks, refer to reference (bn),
Maintenance Training Management and Evaluation Programs (MATMEP).

    e.      Related Standard Occupational Classification (SOC) Title and Code.
None.

       f.   Related Military Skill

            (1) Helicopter Crew Chief, CH-53, 6173.

            (2) Helicopter Crew Chief, UH/AH-1, 6174.

            (3) Tiltrotor Crew Chief, MV-22, 6176.

nlx_method: NLx employer-demand profiles; private-only ownership unverified. Six-digit profiles pool specialty weighted task incidences after the existing review exclusion mask and five-job task-support floor; destination SOCs require 200 postings and nonzero tasks. Military profiles use binary accepted task presence and the same NLx reference RCA weights as civilian profiles: reciprocal positive task shares (zero weight for reference-absent tasks) of pooled retained support-five NLx weighted incidences across 1,016 reference specialties (912 eligible comparison candidates), sqrt(q * rca_weight), then L2 normalization and cosine. No military crosswalk codes enter the task ranking. All positive top-20 results retained; zero-similarity destinations are not recommendations. Shared field/rating duties are included; general Naval Standards remain separate by paygrade. Summary compares non-future individual source entries (versions can repeat) with nonempty reference sets; grouped, future and general-standard entries remain in all outputs. Hit@k is the fraction with at least one reference SOC recovered; ties are averaged exactly. References outside NLx remain in denominators. DMDC reference status is from July 2024, not current 2026 status.
